blocks.text: Original document: [docs/physics_system_documentation.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/physics_system_documentation.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

Retiam integrates **Rapier3D (WASM)** to deliver deterministic, high-performance 3D rigid-body physics directly synchronized with Retiam's Entity-Component-System (ECS) scene graph and WebGPU rendering pipeline.

The physics engine supports over **600+ simultaneous dynamic physical bodies at 60 FPS**, handling collisions, friction, restitution, kinematic animation, compound shapes, and geometric surface simulations.

items: **Use Primitive Colliders Over TriMeshes**: Spheres, Boxes, and Capsules compute in $<10\text{ ns}$ per pair, whereas TriMeshes require BVH traversal.
**Enable CCD Only for Fast Projectiles**: Continuous Collision Detection (`ccd: true`) is essential for bullets or fast balls, but can be disabled for general debris.
**Recycle Off-Screen Entities**: When dynamic entities leave the active gameplay arena, remove them with `physics.remove(entity)` to maintain a steady 60 FPS.
